prompt:
We have an active incident (INC-2024-0201) in our QA infrastructure. All nightly browser automation jobs are failing. The error reported is: 'browser.status timed out - Do NOT retry'. A previous on-call engineer made things worse by retrying repeatedly and then doing a gateway stop followed by a gateway start — neither worked, and they left the incident unresolved.

Your job: investigate what's actually wrong with the browser control pipeline, apply the correct minimal recovery procedure, and produce a file called `recovery_report.json` documenting: (1) the port-level diagnosis of what was up and what was down, (2) the exact action you took to fix it, and (3) the one-sentence message to give the user explaining what happened and what they should do next.

The active incident file is at ops/incident_logs/ACTIVE_INCIDENT.txt. Do not repeat the mistakes in ops/incident_logs/failed_recovery_attempt.txt.
